episodes.title: The Untold Want
episodes.summary: Beth and Rip rebuild their lives in Rio Paloma, Texas, but violent rivals and small‑town tensions threaten their hard‑won peace as they fight to protect their land and family.

episodes.title: Earn Another Day
episodes.summary: Beth and Rip work to forge their new life in Rio Paloma, carrying scars of what they lost and hope for what might rise. As he searches for his place in their fresh start, Carter finds connection with Oreana.

episodes.title: Act of God Business
episodes.summary: As Beth fights to secure their business, Rip confronts a deadly threat. Tensions increase throughout Rio Paloma, and circumstances require everyone to make choices.

episodes.title: Start with a Bullet
episodes.summary: Beth and Rip face a crisis that forces them into extreme action, while Beulah consolidates her power and strengthens her control over the situation.

episodes.title: Peaceful Find Peace
episodes.summary: Beth offers Beulah a high‑stakes deal to secure both their futures.

episodes.title: A Cowboy Saint
episodes.summary: Beth and Beulah chase a deal that could alter everything.

episodes.title: Den of Sin
episodes.summary: A lavish 10 Petal celebration unfolds with Beulah at the helm.

episodes.title: Whiskey Limits
episodes.summary: A storm shakes Rio Paloma. Beth and Rip's choices are put to the test. Beulah's bonds crumble. Joaquin and Will face off. Carter faces a crossroad that might define his future.

episodes.title: El Padrino
episodes.summary: Rip and Beth confront a danger that threatens everything. Season finale.
